route.context: Djinn ranked the wishes without a model: by the words of their titles, their projects and their latest blocks. The request:
route.question: Where does this request go? “{request}”
route.queue: New wish “{title}”, paused until a place frees up
route.stop_words: the and for with this that from into our you your are was can not all but its has have please about what when then there here will would could should also just need want
route.why_far: an existing wish, though little in the request points to it
route.why_keep: the lead found it outside this wish; keep it if it belongs here
route.why_link: it works on {projects}, which the request links to
route.why_name: it works on {projects}, which the request names
route.why_new_far: the closest wish, “{wish}”, is not close enough
route.why_new_none: no wish is close to it
route.why_queue: three wishes are active, so it waits paused
route.why_swap: “{wish}”, the last active one, waits paused instead
route.why_template: the skill {skill} makes this wish: its watcher starts at once, its lead follows the skill
